newsitem.title: THAILAND: RESEARCH ALERT - Accumulate Siam Cement - Merrill.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Accumulate Siam Cement - Merrill.

text.p: Merrill Lynch on Friday recommended investors accumulate Thailand's largest industrial conglomerate Siam Cement Plc on anticipation its share price will rise further this year.
"We see the stock as an intermediate Accumulate with an upside potential of 21 percent over one year to 830 baht per share," Merrill Lynch said in its recent report.
The stock was trading down 16 baht at 672 baht at 0314 GMT.
Merrill Lynch expected Siam Cement group's net profit this year to grow six percent to 7.2 billion baht ($277 million) compared with 6.8 billion in 1996.

The investment bank said the outlook for the Siam Cement group in 1997 was expected to be mixed, with better performance in its cement, steel, machinery and auto parts and metal electrical products businesses.
But it noted that the petrochemical and ceramic units would continue to perform poorly on falling petrochemical prices and slower construction activity.
Siam Cement is also Thailand's largest cement producer controlling 41 percent market share.
